english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone firmly resolved to do something.
Use this when “determined” means firm and unwavering about a decision or course of action.
Use 堅決 for an adamant refusal, decision, or insistence when the speaker will not accept dissent.

examples.english: I am determined not to bow to difficulties.
examples.traditional: 我堅決唔會向困難低頭。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gin1 kyut3 m4 wui5 hoeng3 kwan3 naan4 dai1 tau4

examples.english: We are intent on carrying it through now that we have decided.
examples.traditional: 我哋既然決定咗，就會堅決做落去。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gei3 jin4 kyut3 ding6 zo2 zau6 wui5 gin1 kyut3 zou6 lok6 heoi3

examples.english: I remain firm and will not accept this arrangement.
examples.traditional: 我堅決唔接受呢個安排。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gin1 kyut3 m4 zip3 sau6 ni1 go3 on1 paai4
